claim: Try realistic sample data in one click without reading or saving to the real notebook.
where: home primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter from the home action; inspect IndexedDB keys; leave with Start for real

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker; reload once; set context offline; reload

claim: Exports the full plan as CSV and imports a checked replacement plan.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; inspect download rows; upload a small valid replacement CSV; assert visible replacement

claim: Planning data stays in this browser unless the user exports it; there is no analytics or employee tracking.
sandbox: record every request in a fresh /demo context while adding a job and opening data tools; assert product origin only

claim: Every blocked overlap names the person, shared resource, or service-pair rule responsible.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; add one person and service; assert visible person, shared-resource, and service-pair explanations

claim: Capacity Map Plus groups conflicts across fourteen days.
where: home Plus section, Plus screen, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample where Plus is previewable without payment; add conflicts on offsets 13 and 14; assert day 13 is included and day 14 is excluded

claim: A saved Plus license is checked with Sociobot no more than once per day, and a revoked license disables Plus.
sandbox: fresh normal context; delay and interrupt the first Sociobot verify with reload; assert one request per day; expire the cache; return revoked; assert Plus locks

claim: Capacity Map Plus is shown as a $29 one-time purchase through the registered Sociobot checkout.
where: home facts, home Plus section, Plus screen, README
sandbox: fresh normal context; open the Plus screen; assert exact price wording and registered checkout URL

claim: Core planning and CSV export are free to use without a license or checkout.
sandbox: fresh normal context with no license; create a person, service, and clear job; export CSV; assert no external request or license

claim: Capacity Map does not connect to calendars, make public booking pages, take payments itself, or track employees.
sandbox: fresh demo flow; assert same-origin planner requests, no calendar or booking integration, no payment form, and an external Sociobot checkout link

claim: Capacity Map checks whether service jobs can overlap before saving a booking.
sandbox: fresh demo; add one clear proposed job; open one staff-capacity conflict; assert its reason and disabled save action

claim: License verification sends only the pasted token to Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh normal context with a URL license; intercept verification; assert exact Sociobot endpoint, sole license query parameter, GET method, and no body
